# netbox_journal_entry (Resource)

Manages a NetBox journal entry (`/api/extras/journal-entries/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_tag" "example" {
  name = "example-tag"
  slug = "example-tag"
}

resource "netbox_journal_entry" "example" {
  assigned_object_type = "example"
  assigned_object_id = 1
  comments = "example"
  tags = [netbox_tag.example.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) Assigned Object Id.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) Assigned Object Type.
- `comments` (String) Comments.

### Optional

- `created_by_id` (Number) ID of the User (`netbox_user`).
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `kind` (String) Kind. Valid values: `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_journal_entry can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_journal_entry.example 123
```
